name: Jethro Pastoral Ministry Manager
description: Jethro helps churches keep track of people, families, groups, attendance, pastoral tasks, church services, rosters and documents.

scripts.lint: php -l *.php calls/*.php db_objects/*.php hooks/**/*.php include/*.php members/*.php members/**/*.php public/*.php public/**/*.php scripts/*.php templates/*.php upgrades/*.php upgrades/**/*.php views/*.php
scripts.docs: cd docs && bun install && bun run start
scripts.docs-html: cd docs && bun install && bun run build
scripts.functests: cd tests/functional && bun install && bun run ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test --reporter=list
